info.name: Synaplan Integration
info.summary: Summaries, translations, chat and AI search for your files, powered by Synaplan
info.description:
Bring Synaplan's AI capabilities directly into ownCloud.online:
- Summarize documents with one click - Translate files to multiple languages - Make searchable by AI — let Synaplan answer from your files - Research Chat — AI assistant with knowledge folder and model selection, optional personal memories, and live status (model, language, image/video) - Configurable answer language — set a default and optionally follow each user's interface language - Each person connects their own Synaplan account, gets one created by the administrator, or everyone shares one account
Requires a running Synaplan server.
info.author: Synaplan
